Using GPT-4 as an evaluator in AlpacaEval 1.0, we assess if the trained model can be preferred over the responses generated from text-davinci-003. For AlpacaEval 2.0, we used GPT-4-turbo as an evaluator following the default setting. We assess if the generated responses are favored over those generated from GPT-4.
